description: MOMENT-1-large: T5-large encoder over 8-step patches of a 512-step univariate series, with masked reversible instance normalization; embeddings average patch outputs where the input mask is fully observed.

input.layout: one univariate series per native channel (n, 1, 512), left-padded; input_mask 1 = observed, 0 = padding or unknown hour
input.window: the same 168-hour local week as WBM, placed in the last 168 steps (21 whole patches)
input.output: per channel 1024-d (reduction 'mean' over fully observed patches), concatenated in channel order; a channel with no fully observed patch is zeros with its ok flag false

declared.where: Hugging Face model card at the pinned revision

pretraining_cohort: Time-series Pile (public benchmark series). Not known to include PMData; recorded as 'unknown' because the Pile's full provenance was not audited.
